parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and therefore carries sample-app semantics. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is a sample-app file warrants no-action. The other record lives in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (DebugPanel package), making this a production-vs-sample-app pairing — the canonical restraint pattern. Consolidating the two type aliases would couple production DebugPanel code to sample-app demonstration code, which is undesirable.
